verdict.rationale: Segment publishes a documented Public API with CRUD operations across workspace resources (Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans), full auth/rate-limit/pagination/versioning reference docs, and a downloadable OpenAPI spec, plus a separate Profile API for programmatic querying — all clearly documented for programmatic/agentic use. Missing for 10: no evidence of an official MCP server or llms.txt (probe returned 404) and no independent hands-on validation of API usage by an AI agent.
